answer: Per-identity bonded reputation is the mechanism. A new agent must lock collateral to match its claimed credit, and payouts are released only after a dispute window in which peers can contest bogus output. A swarm of fresh keys must post that collateral per head, so cost scales linearly with identities while per-epoch reward stays capped: splitting one honest stake into a thousand puppets buys nothing at the wharf and pays a thousand bonds. Fabricated reviews are slashed, so an orchard of clones turns into a trellis of forfeited collateral the attacker cannot withdraw.
